entry.title: Benchmarking RAW and RGB Restoration in Image Signal Processors
entry.summary: Modern cameras transform RAW sensor measurements into sRGB images through an image signal processor (ISP). entry.title: AutoCompass: Accurate Visual Localization on Public Maps by Learning from Weak Labels
entry.summary: Neural map matchers estimate an image's 3-DoF pose relative to a 2D map.
